$comment: HumanGateway protocol v1.0.0 (2026-08-28). SYNC-FR-01..07. The sync model: durable IDs (common.$defs.id), per-gateway sequence numbers (sequence), opaque cursors (cursor), idempotency (batchId + idempotencyKey), and content hashes (common.$defs.contentHash).
title: SyncBatch
description: A cursor-based, idempotent batch of sync operations exchanged between an Edge Gateway and the Relay (SYNC-FR-03). Encodes the sync model: durable IDs, per-gateway sequence numbers, cursors, idempotency keys, and content hashes (SYNC-FR-01, SYNC-FR-02). Every item carries a per-gateway monotonic sequence number so receivers reorder deterministically and tolerate out-of-order arrival (SYNC-FR-07). A batch with an empty items array is a valid keepalive/cursor-advance batch (SYNC-FR-03).

allOf.description: A non-empty batch MUST declare the sequence range of its items (sequenceStart <= sequenceEnd; item sequences fall within it). Empty (keepalive) batches MUST leave both null.

batchId.description: Durable batch ID. A retry of the same batch MUST reuse the same batchId — the receiver deduplicates on it (idempotency, SYNC-FR-02).

gatewayId.description: The gateway that created this batch — the unique Edge Gateway identity (AUTH-FR-01, gateway.schema.json#/gatewayId). The Relay rejects batches from unregistered, suspended, or revoked gateways (SP-02).

direction.description: PUSH: gateway → Relay. PULL: Relay → gateway. The receiving side applies the items and responds with a result batch.

sinceCursor.description: Opaque cursor supplied by the receiving side for incremental sync; null on the first exchange (SYNC-FR-03). Never interpreted by the sender — only stored and echoed back.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor the receiver must store and return on the next exchange, covering all items in this batch.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable per-batch key; the receiver deduplicates by batchId/idempotencyKey so replayed batches have no duplicate effect (SYNC-FR-02). A retry of the same batch MUST reuse the same batchId AND idempotencyKey; changing either creates a new logical batch.

sequenceStart.description: Smallest per-gateway sequence number in this batch. Required (non-null) when items is non-empty; MUST be null for an empty keepalive batch. Combined with sequenceEnd for gap detection.

sequenceEnd.description: Largest per-gateway sequence number in this batch. Required (non-null) when items is non-empty; MUST be null for an empty keepalive batch.

items.description: The sync operations in this batch. May be empty: an empty batch advances the cursor without carrying items (keepalive, SYNC-FR-03).

cursor.description: An opaque, URL-safe cursor token issued by the receiving side (SYNC-FR-03). Senders MUST NOT parse or interpret its content; they only store it and echo it back on the next exchange. Null means 'no position yet' (first exchange). Bounded to 1024 chars to keep cursors database- and URL-friendly.

sequence.description: Per-gateway monotonic sequence number. The deterministic ordering key: receivers reorder items by (gatewayId, sequence) (SYNC-FR-07). Gaps are allowed (retries); contiguity is not required. A batch declares its span via sequenceStart/sequenceEnd.

deliveryAck.title: Delivery Acknowledgement
deliveryAck.description: A delivery acknowledgement returned to the sender: the recipient gateway confirms DELIVERED / ACKNOWLEDGED, or reports FAILED (SYNC-FR-05).

state.description: Outcome being reported back to the sender.

syncItem.title: SyncItem
syncItem.description: One unit of sync work, discriminated by 'kind': message, delivery, artifact, or ack. Artifact items carry artifact metadata only — the bytes travel over the separate chunked artifact-transfer channel (PROTO-FR-04 exception).

oneOf.title: Message item
oneOf.description: A message envelope pushed to the receiving side.

oneOf.title: Delivery item
oneOf.description: A delivery-state update for a message the receiving side already has.

oneOf.title: Artifact item
oneOf.description: Artifact metadata (id + hash + size + mimeType + filename). The receiving gateway uses the hash to deduplicate and to verify bytes delivered over the chunked transfer channel.

oneOf.title: Acknowledgement item
oneOf.description: A delivery acknowledgement returned to the sender (SYNC-FR-05).
